{{Quote|My master always says that I am too trusting, too willing to show weakness.|Kel Algwinn|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
This [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] was the master of [[Sith hopeful]] [[Kel Algwinn]] during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR game" />

==History==
Around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Sith Master became the master of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Sith hopeful Kel Algwinn. Kel would later mention his Sith Master to the former Sith Lord and [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in the Sith Academy on Korriban when Kel was expressing his doubts about the Sith and if he really belonged at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="KotOR game" />

==Personality and traits==
The Sith Master was very strict, ruthless, and hard on Kel. He berated Kel numerous times for what he viewed as Kel being too trusting and too willing to show weakness to other people.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kel Algwinn's Sith Master was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in a dialogue when Kel tells Revan his doubts about the Sith. This dialogue is part of a side quest where the player has the option to convince Kel to leave the Sith and join the Jedi.<ref name="KotOR game" />
